question: What isolation contract should OpenClaw support for memory-wiki and other plugin-owned memory config on a shared multi-agent gateway?
rationale: The fix can add a broad per-agent plugin config API, a memory-wiki-specific context-aware vault resolver, or an explicit unsupported stance; each choice changes config compatibility, plugin API expectations, and sensitive memory isolation guarantees.

options.title: Generic per-agent plugin config
options.body: Add a typed agents.list[].plugins.entries override contract, make memory-wiki consume it, and require docs, schema, upgrade, and isolation tests for fresh and existing installs.

options.title: Memory-wiki-only context vault
options.body: Keep the general plugin API unchanged and resolve memory-wiki vault paths from trusted agent/workspace context at each operation, accepting that other plugins remain separately tracked.

options.title: Document separate-gateway isolation only
options.body: Do not add a new config surface now; document that memory-wiki is gateway-global and that sensitive tenant boundaries require separate gateways.

recommendation.title: Generic per-agent plugin config
recommendation.body: Add a typed agents.list[].plugins.entries override contract, make memory-wiki consume it, and require docs, schema, upgrade, and isolation tests for fresh and existing installs.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc introduced the memory-wiki surfaces and recently touched per-agent memory storage behavior, making them the best history-backed owner for the isolation contract choice.
